profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Stag
profile.summary:
Rick has spent a considerable amount of time designing and implementing data structures, security, transactions, and indexes in large scale distributed systems.  Sometimes people pay him to do this. 

Rick would describe his greatest skill as his ability to connect people and ideas from disparate disciplines.  Sometimes people pay him to do this.  

Rick's hobbies include esoteric (and practical) programming language evaluation.  He currently spends as much time as possible on Rust and Elm.

positions.title: Sr. Distributed Database Engineer
positions.description: Turning data into information, and information into knowledge.

positions.description: Oversees an army of robots as they build and rebuild Letter's infrastructure.

positions.title: Director of Solutions
positions.description: I make things go.

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description:
* Ensure that Agilestacks products exceed all customer expectations.  
* Coordinate and execute large-scale enterprise deployments. 
* Facilitate ongoing success of customers via community and educational efforts.

positions.title: VP Engineering
positions.description: Run an organization dedicated to building seriously powerful technology that delights customers in new an innovative ways.

positions.title: Señor Software
positions.description:
* Design and implementation of distributed data collection and event monitoring system. 
* Implementation of low latency networked applications
* Provide snarky comments regarding the state of information technology. 
* Prototype new data visualization technologies.

positions.title: Architect
positions.description:
Designed systemic infrastructure solutions for : 
* Compliance
* Cloud Security
* Encrypted Storage
* Local and Remote Message Authenticity

Worked with Product Teams and Business to implement and deploy solutions.

positions.title: Team Lead - Product Security
positions.description:
Oversaw a team responsible for auditing of design and implementation of Bloomberg Products for Security and Compliance. 

Ran a team of engineers which helped design secure client and server systems as well as implement them according to secure programming guidelines.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built news ingest system which managed a many-stage process for analyzing, classifying, and indexing hundreds of thousands of news stories and articles daily. 

Built a personalized viewership activity auditor system for personalizing recommendations and also for compliance oriented long-term storage.
